scope: Shared native file/publication/enumeration ownership and SQLite actual file lifetimes in existing crates
256 native I/O slots, with Directory/LockGuard paying the existing 128-owner subset too
NativeFile exports and bounded cloning; preserve native identity, mount, private/DACL, provider policy and old records
Remove Unix metadata and parent-sync duplicates; no end-to-end speed claim

limits.quotaWait: atomic refusal; no waiting for slots

semantics.ownership: Native factories reserve before syscall/mkdir/create. Owner field order closes file before lease release. NativeFile owns File+lease, has no Into<File>/IntoRawFd/DerefMut. Arc shares one owner. Unix DIR stream owns its lease until closedir. Windows ReOpenFile and relative open/query/remove use charged files.
semantics.import: NativeFile::admit only transfers an already open descriptor into admission, closing the transferred file on refusal. It establishes no filesystem, identity, provider or deletion authority. Borrowed File/raw handle aliases intentionally made outside try_clone are excluded.
semantics.sqlite: Storage and Registered now carry NativeFile. Context DB/sidecars, C State and SHM retain leases. Retired foreign C files count through actual xClose/final Arc close. No additional database FD for identity/size; mapped index and OFD contracts unchanged.
semantics.errors: Both marker units preserve Cache ResourceLimit / Core and Audit native entry StateResourceLimit. Journal keeps marked Io. SQLite callbacks still return database I/O errors and do not promise typed native units for all SQL failures.
semantics.exclusions: Scanners, Windows security token query handles, external files before admit, independently duplicated borrowed handles, whole-process handles/RSS, hard deadlines and terminal-persistence reserved handles. Component-only audit disk/name APIs, future spill and noncooperating actors remain outside the global state audit.
semantics.oracle: Fresh exec with literal limits; ordinary descriptor enumeration/fstat or Windows executive handle query, no production counter/reset. Verify no creation at cap, old bytes, Arc lifetime, one-slot active enumeration/encoder, callback refusal/panic cleanup, concurrent actual duplicates and imported failure close.
semantics.consumerOracle: Existing Core public fixture runs isolated authority and I/O modes, checks snapshot load/save/new root, Audit integrity/manifest/new namespace refusal plus old bytes and release recovery. Windows audit unsupported as before.
semantics.foreignOracle: Existing 64-context fixture preserved; 192 charged real duplicates exhaust I/O. Retired original descriptor queried independently with fcntl before C close, EBADF immediately after; context-only refusal still tested with one free I/O slot. Original context regression not replaced.
semantics.unchanged: No manifest/dependency/new crate, wire enum rename, rule or scanning strategy change, new platform support, publishing, permanent deletion or emptied Trash.
semantics.postMatrixChanges: Only public rustdoc and aligned documentation changed after final functional checks; behavior unchanged.
